description: Source code defining the SsmSapClient class within the AWS SDK for interacting with the AWS Systems Manager for SAP service. It includes method annotations for various API operations related to SAP resource management.

classes.name: SsmSapClient
classes.description: Client class for AWS Systems Manager for SAP service, extending the base AwsClient class, with methods for managing SAP resources.

methods.description: Method annotations indicating available API operations such as deleteResourcePermission, deregisterApplication, getApplication, listApplications, startApplication, stopApplication, tagResource, untagResource, updateApplicationSettings, and their asynchronous counterparts.
